[batch narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] This Vantage Data Centers facility, WA11, is part of Vantages Quincy campus in Grant County, Washington. Per Vantages own official page for Quincy (tier-1 operator source, https://vantage-dc.com/data-center-locations/north-america/quincy-washington/), this campus at 2101 M Street NE, Quincy, WA 98848, totals 775,000 square feet and 89 MW of critical IT load across three data centers, matching the three WA1-numbered rows (WA11, WA12, WA13) this registry tracks at this campus. Because the 89 MW and 775,000 sq ft figures are campus-wide totals across all three buildings, not confirmed as this specific buildings own figure, they are not applied to critical_it_mw. Vantages own site specifically credits WA11 with Tier III certification and LEED Gold status, the operators current page does not break out WA11s individual MW or square footage figure separate from the three-building campus total. A prior research pass on this row consisted mainly of operator-level company history rather than Quincy-specific facts, that operator-level history is retained alongside this facility-specific addition.
